content.short: Delea Finance is a decentralized borrowing protocol on TON that allows users to mint DONE stablecoins.
content.description: Delea Finance is a robust decentralized borrowing platform (CDP) built on the TON blockchain, designed to provide users with efficient access to liquidity. It allows participants to deposit over-collateralized assets, such as Toncoin or liquid staking tokens, to mint the DONE stablecoin in a secure and non-custodial manner. Delea Finance focuses on capital efficiency and transparency, providing the essential infrastructure for users to unlock the value of their holdings without selling them. It is a core component of the growing decentralized credit market within the TON DeFi ecosystem.
